items.title: Fake Microsoft Teams installers push Oyster malware via malvertising
items.description: Hackers have been spotted using SEO poisoning and search engine advertisements to promote fake Microsoft Teams installers that infect Windows devices with the Oyster backdoor, providing initial access to corporate networks. [...]
